capture_source: live capture 2026-10-27, NW RFC SDK registered server (program ID ZFTNT_SIGTEST) idle for 633 s against SAP A4H gateway 192.168.88.7:3300 (sapgw00); file rfc_typeT-registered_server_idle.pcap, packet 11
notes: Gateway -> registered server, unprompted, at +316.6 s and +632.0 s of an idle registration. The SDK answered the first with a TCP ACK only: no RFC frame, and it kept listening.
saprfclib idle run the same day (12 min, same gateway): identical frame at +315.4 s and +629.5 s except [76:80] (00001800 there, 00001c00 here).
[40:48] '0000007\x00' is not a conversation ID usable for a reply; calls are always preceded by 06cf carrying the real one.
Contains no host or IP data; no sanitisation needed.
Offsets are FILE offsets (NI 4-byte header included).
